# GitHub Actions disabled

GitHub Actions are intentionally disabled for this deprecated repository as of
September 1, 2026. No push, pull-request, scheduled, or manually dispatched
workflow remains active.

The final workflow definitions are retained under
`.github/archived-workflows/` as historical release and security evidence. Do
not move them back into this directory. Active CLI development and automation
continue in [chistiq/workspai](https://github.com/chistiq/workspai).
